recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的芽細胞細胞質內含一個或數個圓形、淡藍至粉紅色的大型球狀包涵體，外觀類似漿細胞的 Russell 小體；插圖切片中的細胞同樣含嗜伊紅圓形小球，電子顯微鏡則顯示細胞內一個大型、界限清楚的圓形包涵體——這是罕見的「類 Russell 小體」B 淋巴芽細胞白血病型態。
features: Panel A: large blasts with irregular nuclei and moderate basophilic, finely granular cytoplasm
Round, pale blue-gray to pink, sharply defined intracytoplasmic globular inclusions resembling Russell bodies
Inclusions vary in size and may indent or displace the nucleus
Inset (tissue section): cells containing bright eosinophilic round cytoplasmic globules
Panel B (electron micrograph): large round homogeneous intracytoplasmic inclusion surrounded by compressed cytoplasm
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (A) shows blasts with high-to-moderate nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and basophilic cytoplasm, several of which contain one or more large, round, homogeneous pale blue to pink cytoplasmic globules resembling Russell bodies; the inset shows corresponding eosinophilic globules in a tissue section. Transmission electron microscopy (B) demonstrates a large, round, homogeneous intracytoplasmic inclusion. These inclusions are not specific for plasma cell differentiation. In the context of a Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with B-ALL with Russell-like cytoplasmic inclusions; lineage assignment rests on flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, TdT) and BCR::ABL1 testing.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Mott cells are mature plasma cells with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof that are CD138+/CD45-/TdT-, not TdT+ CD19+ blasts.
Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules are MPO-positive azurophilic granules in myeloblasts, whereas these inclusions occur in MPO-negative B-lineage blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or rhabdoid tumor cells
ddx.vs: Signet-ring cells contain mucin vacuoles and rhabdoid cells contain intermediate filament whorls, and both are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
